description: French commune lookup (Etalab/INSEE commune register): INSEE code, postcodes, population, department, region, centre point and area. Look up by name or INSEE code, or pass lat+lon to find the commune containing a point. Example: "population of Lyon" -> 69123, 519,127.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84); pair with lon to find the commune at a point.

limit.description: Max communes for a name search, 1-20 (default 5).

name.description: Commune name, e.g. "Lyon". Returns the best matches.

name: fr_commune
